title: The kb_tools MCP tool, one AGENTS.md line and kb_ask.py's routing send a which-tool question to the catalog
goal: the kb MCP server lists a read-only kb_tools tool (need, optional) that returns kbtools.py's lines; AGENTS.md names kbtools.py as the first step when an agent does not know which tool answers, staying within its 4096-byte cap by a cut elsewhere; kb_ask.py --route maps a which-tool or how-do-I question (fixed cue words, as mon_status.topic_of does) to kind=tools and answers it with kbtools.py, no pack and no model

run:
import re, shlex, subprocess, sys

agents = open('AGENTS.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
size = len(agents.encode('utf-8'))
lines = [l for l in agents.splitlines() if 'kbtools.py' in l]
if not lines:
    print('AGENTS.md does not name kbtools.py; bytes', size)
    sys.exit(1)
line = lines[0]
m = re.search(r'python3 _tools/kbtools\.py[^`]*', line)
if not m:
    print('the line gives no command of the form python3 _tools/kbtools.py ...:', line.strip()[:120])
    sys.exit(1)
cmd = re.sub(r'<[^>]*>|\[[^\]]*\]|\b[A-Z]{3,}\b', 'sprint cost tokens dollars', m.group(0))
r = subprocess.run(shlex.split(cmd), capture_output=True, text=True)  # the command the line gives, run as written
says = 'tool' in line.lower().replace('kbtools.py', '')  # the line says what the command is for
print('AGENTS.md bytes', size, '| command:', cmd, '| exit', r.returncode, '| names the tool', 'backlog.py' in r.stdout, '| says what it is for', says)
sys.exit(0 if size <= 4096 and r.returncode == 0 and 'backlog.py' in r.stdout and says else 1)

import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile

d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='fake-claude-')
marker = os.path.join(d, 'called')
fake = os.path.join(d, 'claude')  # a model call would run this, not the real CLI, and leave the marker
open(fake, 'w').write('#!/bin/sh\necho called >> ' + marker + '\nexit 1\n')
os.chmod(fake, 0o755)
env = dict(os.environ, PATH=d + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'], KB_NO_REVALIDATE='1')

def ask(*args):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kb_ask.py', *args], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=120)

asks = ['which tool shows how long each landing step took', 'which command prints what a sprint item cost',
        'how do I find the command that lists the stalled backlog items']
docs = ['how do I enroll a Windows device in Autopilot', 'which Intune policy type configures BitLocker encryption',
        'what does the compliance policy setting for BitLocker require']
routed = {q: ask('--route', q).stdout for q in asks + docs}
good = all('kind=tools' in routed[q] for q in asks) and not any('kind=tools' in routed[q] for q in docs)
answer = ask(asks[0]) if good else None  # the answer itself: the lines of kbtools.py, no model
first = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kbtools.py', asks[0]], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.splitlines()
ok = (good and answer.returncode == 0 and 'backlog.py' in answer.stdout and bool(first) and first[0] in answer.stdout
      and not os.path.exists(marker))
print('routes', {q[:30]: r.splitlines()[0][:30] if r else '' for q, r in routed.items()}, '| answer exit',
      answer.returncode if answer else None, '| model called', os.path.exists(marker))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
